description: This file defines the MutatorService class, which implements various item mutation and synchronization functionalities for a note-taking application. It manages items, handles encryption, import/export, and interacts with multiple services and managers.

classes.name: MutatorService
classes.description: A service class that manages item mutations, synchronization, encryption, and import/export functionalities within the application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references to services and managers when the MutatorService is deinitialized.

methods.name: insertItem
methods.description: Inserts a new decrypted item into the system, returning the inserted item.

methods.name: changeAndSaveItem
methods.description: Changes and saves a single item, optionally updating timestamps and syncing.

methods.name: changeAndSaveItems
methods.description: Changes and saves multiple items, with optional timestamp updates and sync.

methods.name: changeItem
methods.description: Changes a single item and returns the updated item.

methods.name: changeItems
methods.description: Changes multiple items.

methods.name: runTransactionalMutations
methods.description: Executes multiple transactional mutations.

methods.name: runTransactionalMutation
methods.description: Executes a single transactional mutation.

methods.name: protectItems
methods.description: Protects a list of items, marking them as protected and syncing.

methods.name: unprotectItems
methods.description: Unprotects items after authorization, then syncs.

methods.name: protectNote
methods.description: Protects a note.

methods.name: unprotectNote
methods.description: Unprotects a note after authorization.

methods.name: protectNotes
methods.description: Protects multiple notes.

methods.name: unprotectNotes
methods.description: Unprotects multiple notes.

methods.name: protectFile
methods.description: Protects a file item.

methods.name: unprotectFile
methods.description: Unprotects a file item after authorization.

methods.name: mergeItem
methods.description: Merges an item into the system, emitting it with a specified source.

methods.name: createTemplateItem
methods.description: Creates a new template item with specified content type and optional content/override.

methods.name: setItemNeedsSync
methods.description: Marks an item as needing synchronization.

methods.name: setItemsNeedsSync
methods.description: Marks multiple items as needing synchronization.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a specified item.

methods.name: deleteItems
methods.description: Deletes multiple items.

methods.name: emptyTrash
methods.description: Empties the trash, deleting all items marked for deletion.

methods.name: duplicateItem
methods.description: Duplicates an item, optionally adding additional content.

methods.name: migrateTagsToFolders
methods.description: Migrates tags to folders and syncs.

methods.name: setTagParent
methods.description: Sets a parent for a tag.

methods.name: unsetTagParent
methods.description: Removes parent from a tag.

methods.name: findOrCreateTag
methods.description: Finds or creates a tag by title.

methods.name: createTagOrSmartView
methods.description: Creates a tag or smart view without syncing.

methods.name: toggleComponent
methods.description: Toggles a component's active state and syncs.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Toggles a theme component and syncs.

methods.name: importData
methods.description: Imports backup data, decrypts, and integrates items, with optional sync.
